finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full outage.**

`redis` connection lost at `02:14:07` (`ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`). Cache fell back to direct store reads, causing cache miss storms and timeouts.

Redis never came back. 12 reconnect attempts failed over 17 minutes, one roughly every 90s-2min.

Queue depth climbed the whole time, `52` to `568` (max `500`). Store timeouts fired every few seconds throughout.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` and restarted. At `02:31:52` `[supervisor]` found `api` unresponsive and killed the process group.

Root cause: Redis went unreachable at `10.0.0.12:6379` and stayed down, no failover, so load piled up until a worker OOM'd and took the service with it.

Next: fix Redis reachability at `10.0.0.12:6379` and add a queue-depth circuit breaker so one dead dependency can't OOM the fleet.
